premises.text: Labor shortages across construction, agriculture, restaurants, and manufacturing create large economic damage
premises.evidence_span: There is a labor crisis in the US across the construction, agriculture, restaurant, and manufacturing industries

premises.text: Factory industrial robots with external control boxes, strain-wave gears, and extreme precision do not fit everyday automation jobs
premises.evidence_span: Robotic innovation has focused on factory automation that doesn't translate well to everyday automation

premises.text: Affordable planetary gears, onboard power from standard outlets or 48V DC, and a novel joint design make the arm cheaper and more deployable
premises.evidence_span: We've opted for proven planetary gears that are 97% efficient and 20% the cost of strain wave gears

premises.text: Quick-change actuators and application-specific robotic skins make the arm easy to service and adapt across environments
premises.evidence_span: anyone will be able to service the robot just like replacing the batteries in your flashlight

premises.text: Imitation learning and microbehaviors let non-experts program the arm by demonstration instead of costly professional training
premises.evidence_span: even my five-year-old will be able to program the robot by showing it, and the robot will then repeat that task

premises.text: NVIDIA Isaac edge compute, AI, and simulation accelerate development tools usable by anyone, not only developers
premises.evidence_span: collaborating with NVIDIA to adopt the Isaac platform for edge compute, AI, and simulation

value.text: Smart, affordable, easy-to-service robotic arms that anyone can train for everyday automation
value.evidence_span: The Ally Arm is the smartest, most affordable, easy-to-service, and simple-to-train robotic arm

causal_links.evidence_span: We must create the right tool for the right job
significantly expand the market for robotic technology and everyday automation

notes: Hardware cost/power/joint features folded into P3 as one affordability mechanism; skins and quick-change kept as serviceability/adaptability. LOI and monthly services traction excluded per 4.2. Anti-template: labor need, hardware, and learning stack are separately revisable.
